entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: subquery over %T is unsupported
entries.rationale: SubqueryExpr.Expr must type-check as an instant vector, and every instant-vector AST shape is dispatched (selector, call, paren, aggregate, binary, unary, plus the parser-impossible nested SubqueryExpr handled defensively); scalar- and string-typed inners are parse-time type errors.

guard: past exhaustive switch inner := e.Expr.(type) over [case *parser.VectorSelector; case *parser.Call; case *parser.ParenExpr; case *parser.AggregateExpr; case *parser.BinaryExpr; case *parser.UnaryExpr; case *parser.SubqueryExpr]

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: subquery over aggregation of %T is unsupported
entries.rationale: An aggregation's argument must type-check as an instant vector, and every instant-vector AST shape is dispatched (paren, call, selector, binary, unary, nested aggregate); scalar- and string-typed inners are parse-time type errors.

guard: past exhaustive switch inner := expr.(type) over [case *parser.ParenExpr; case *parser.Call; case *parser.VectorSelector; case *parser.BinaryExpr; case *parser.UnaryExpr; case *parser.AggregateExpr]

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: subquery over absent() requires query eval-time context (use LowerAt)
entries.rationale: The HTTP handlers always thread eval times via LowerAt / LowerAtRange; only the raw Lower() entrypoint (tests / tooling) can present a zero eval anchor to this guard.
